notes.title: Börd Killer: Upcoming update, price change, and the FUTURE™
notes.notes:
[h2][h1]Hello Börd Killers,[/h1][/h2]

[h3]By FEBURARY 1ST THERE SHALL BE A BORD KILLER UPDATE! AND IT SHALL BE GLORIOUS!
[/h3]


[b]Here are some new features that will be included! 
[/b]
- sledgehammer!
- BUG FIXESSS
- You can now select [b]modifiers[/b] for each round! Some of these modifiers include
     1. Big bords (!!!!!!)
     2. Double spawnrate (woah!!!)
     3. BORDS WITH GUNS!!! (WOW)
- Poultrindex...
- secrets...? (definitely not a fart button)
- more settings!
- changes to existing maps
- more advanced börd behavior
- more updgrades!

[h3]Wow! What an update! Ok well whats in the future?
[/h3]

Uh... Hello?!?!?!? Multiplayer?????? Already semi-functioning????

Round-based systems allowing for replayability??? and fun???

Special rounds with that involve explosions?

emotes??? (maybe)

more weapons?? (frying pan, magic wand?)

Voice acting???????????????? By my dad lol and some others

Improved bords whatever that means lol



[h3]Price Change
[/h3]

On a sadder note, I have decided that I will start charging around $0.99-$2.99 for the game once this update is released. this is to support me and development (it takes a lot to be the greatest game dev of all time... ). of course, if you have already 'bought' the game, you will not have to purchase another license. so you should tell all your [b]friends[/b] and [b]colleagues[/b] about bord killer while its free!!!!


i love you all <3 and thank you for playing bord killer and the future is bright!

Godspeed,
nibblenibble123 
bord killer dev

notes.title: Game Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Börd Killer is out!

I am very sorry for the delay. Lots of things going on outside of this game, on top of some computer issues (almost lost the entire project!). Thank you all for your support and patience!! This is the first game I've released on steam, and I look forward to improving it and adding more content.

Many thanks,
nibblenibble123
